title: Deus Ex Machina: Power, Perception and Prejudice
summary: A student project examining bias and fairness in AI systems using the Adult Census Income dataset, testing bias-mitigation techniques and fairness-accuracy trade-offs. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer (with SingleTableMetadata/Metadata, conditional sampling via sdv.sampling.Condition, and evaluate_quality/run_diagnostic) to generate and evaluate synthetic tabular data for the fairness experiments.
evidence: Tutorial.ipynb: 'from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer' and 'synthesizer.fit(data2)' with TVAESynthesizer, plus evaluate_quality/run_diagnostic calls
